subject: English
passage: As Dr. Erik Lindqvist and his team of researchers discovered when establishing the fossil dating chronology of North America, the Rocky Mountains—a 4,800-km mountain range spanning the continent—are home to dinosaur fossils of at least 75 million years in age. ______ the researchers concluded, certain dinosaur species existed in North America long before the mass extinction event 66 million years ago.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer because 'thus' logically signals that the conclusion follows from the evidence presented. The first sentence establishes that fossils in the Rocky Mountains are at least 75 million years old. The second sentence draws the logical conclusion that dinosaurs existed before the mass extinction event 66 million years ago. Since fossils dated to 75 million years ago predate an event from 66 million years ago, 'thus' properly indicates this cause-and-effect relationship between evidence and conclusion.
